scope: Synthetic spherical MVI adaptation; all outcomes retained. Completed execution is not certification of free model recovery. Oracle fits use truth.
adaptations: Independent volume quadrature, fixed seeded noise, finite 20/40/20 iteration budgets, CG 200 at 1e-4, cap 10 SI, beta ratio 10. Modern SDK defaults for active_set_grad_scale, misfit_tolerance and IRLS f_min_change; not publication field-result reproduction.
